minimum_behavior.no_replay: one command transmission at most; a timeout or ambiguous result is not retried
minimum_behavior.read_continuation_only: reserved by the public policy type; every first-version backend fails before transmission, while a future capable backend may continue only the current response and never resend the command
minimum_behavior.unsupported_continuation: fail closed before transmission with attempts=0 and a structured non-replayable transport error
minimum_behavior.safe_to_replay: the caller explicitly opts in; the transport never infers safety from command text
minimum_behavior.consuming_reads: read-to-clear registers and acquisition-bound *OPC? use no_replay
minimum_behavior.partial_response: return a structured, non-replayable TransportIOError carrying response_progress and synchronization evidence; telemetry is not the contract source
minimum_behavior.legacy_query_default: unclassified legacy calls remain source-compatible but use no_replay by default
minimum_behavior.structured_errors: record whether the command was transmitted, whether bytes arrived, and whether the channel may be desynchronized
minimum_behavior.telemetry: may record approved non-sensitive operational metrics but does not replace structured replay, response-progress, or synchronization evidence
minimum_behavior.backends: PyVISA, RsInstrument, Serial, GuardedAuditedTransport, and FakeTransport share the same contract

acceptance: a failed no_replay query sends at most one command
every first-version backend rejects read_continuation_only before transmission with attempts=0
a future backend with declared continuation support may continue the current response but never resend the command
*OPC? can be marked no_replay for acquisition synchronization
read-to-clear errors cannot be silently replayed
TransportIOError records replay policy, response progress, and communication synchronization without sensitive payloads

transitions.new_or_reconnected_session: healthy communication channel with an empty verified_fields set; no previous configuration trust is inherited
transitions.preflight_rejection: no I/O and session remains healthy
transitions.readback_failure: uncertain with only bounded restoration and verification I/O allowed

restore_failure.error_priority: preserve TransportIOError or SessionHealthError when the restoration or verification exchange fails; use StateDriftError only for an independently observed semantic or readback mismatch

transitions.restore_success: uncertain returns to healthy only when communication is synchronized and the related field closure passes independent readback; only proven fields are added to verified_fields
transitions.health_degradation: leaving healthy clears verified_fields for the current epoch
transitions.close: closed; reconnect creates a new healthy communication session with an empty verified_fields set
